papers.title: Higher-Order Moments of Correlated Multivariate Hermite Polynomials
papers.summary: Stochastic Galerkin methods reformulate a differential equation with uncertain parameters as a deterministic surrogate system by writing the solution as a series of polynomial basis functionals and projecting onto the parameter space. Given correlated Gaussian parameters, Rahman (2017) established solution convergence when the basis functionals are multivariate Hermite polynomials (MHPs), which is the setting considered here. Each term of the original equation contributes coefficients to the surrogate system, which we call the $N$th moments, that are expectations of products of the basis polynomials. Since the parameters are dependent, the $N$th moments do not factor into one-dimensional expectations via tensorization as they do in the independent case; consequently, their values are typically determined numerically at a nontrivial and compounding cost. Namely, the number of $N$th moments that emerge grows combinatorially with parameter dimension and truncation order. In this paper, we first relate MHPs and slowly growing functions --- which are smooth functions whose derivatives of all orders grow at most polynomially --- in correlated Gaussian parameters. In doing so, we derive an expression for the $N$th moment of an MHPs in terms of $(N-1)$th moments that can be evaluated exactly, along with sufficient conditions for the $N$th moment to vanish. Numerical examples illustrate the benefit of evaluating such moments directly without numerical approximation and confirm that formula-predicted values match sampling-based estimates.
papers.title_ja: 相関付き多変数エルミート多項式の高次モーメント
papers.summary_ja: 確率ギャルキン法において、相関付きガウスパラメータに対する多変数エルミート多項式（MHP）の高次モーメントを効率的に計算する手法を提案する。従来は数値積分やサンプリングが必要だったモーメント計算を、低次モーメントを用いた再帰式と消失条件の導出により、厳密かつ高速に評価可能にする。これにより、パラメータ次元や截断次数が増加しても計算コストの爆発を抑制し、不確実性を含む微分方程式のサロゲートモデル構築を効率化する。数値例により、この解析的アプローチがサンプリング法と一致し、計算負荷を大幅に軽減することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 不確実性モデリングにおけるサロゲートモデル構築の効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Is Not Explainability
papers.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) allows language models to verbalise multi-step rationales before producing their final answer. While this technique often boosts task performance and offers an impression of transparency into the model's reasoning, this position paper argues that rationales generated by current CoT techniques can be misleading and are neither necessary nor sufficient for trustworthy interpretability. We analyse faithfulness as whether CoTs are not only human-interpretable but also reflect the model's underlying reasoning well enough to support responsible use. By synthesising evidence from prior work, we systematically show that verbalised chains are frequently unfaithful, diverging from the critical hidden computations that drive a model's predictions. As CoT is increasingly relied upon in application domains, including high-stakes ones such as medicine, law, and autonomous systems, we further argue that this unfaithfulness is not taken seriously enough in these settings: our analysis of 1,000 recent CoT-centric papers finds that approximately 21.7% explicitly treat CoT as a load-bearing interpretability technique, building pipelines or safety arguments that would not hold if CoT is unfaithful to the model's actual reasoning. They include papers in high-stakes domains that heavily hinge on such interpretability claims. Building on prior work, we make three proposals: (i) avoid treating CoT as being sufficient for interpretability without additional verification, (ii) adopt rigorous methods that assess faithfulness for downstream decision-making, and (iii) report such assessments alongside any interpretability claims based on CoT, while continuing to use CoT for its communicative and monitoring benefits.
papers.title_ja: Chain-of-Thoughtは説明可能性ではない
papers.summary_ja: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) による推論過程の可視化が、モデルの実際の内部計算と一致しない（忠実でない）場合が多いことを指摘するポジションペーパーである。CoT は人間にとって解釈可能であっても、モデルの予測を駆動する隠れた計算から乖離しており、信頼できる解釈可能性とは言い切れないと論じる。医療や法律など高リスク分野で CoT を根拠とする安全性の主張が約21.7%存在する現状を分析し、CoT の忠実性を検証する厳密な手法の採用と、解釈可能性の主張に伴う評価報告を提案する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の推論透明性・ハルシネーション対策・実務適用の信頼性評価に直結する重要論文

papers.title: GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections
papers.summary: Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.
papers.title_ja: GHC: ハイパーコネクションにおける残差インターフェースの拡張
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、並列ストリーム間の残差容量を拡張するハイパーコネクションのボトルネックを解消する手法「グループド・ハイパーコネクション（GHC）」を提案する。各ブランチをアテンションヘッドやFFNチャネルに沿ってグループ化し、グループごとに異なるストリーム混合を供給することで、従来の単一インターフェースの制約を打破する。高密度モデルとMoEモデルでの実験により、パラメータやメモリアクセスのオーバーヘッドをほぼ増やさずに、Pre-Norm比で35%、IHC比で10%の訓練効率向上を実現したことを示す。また、残差インターフェースの拡張により、ストリーム追加に伴う逓減効果を超え、より広い残差状態からさらなる性能向上を得られることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのアーキテクチャ効率化と訓練高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: ModernELECTRA: Replaced-Token Detection with Boundary-Window Reconstruction for Compact Encoders that Classify and Embed
papers.summary: ELECTRA-style replaced-token detection (RTD) is a sample-efficient objective for pre-training text encoders, and RTD-trained models such as DeBERTaV3 are strong on classification benchmarks. The same models, however, are known to be poor backbones for embedding tasks such as retrieval and semantic similarity: the binary "original vs. replaced" signal does not ask the final layer to retain the token identity and contextual content that dense representations rely on. We introduce ModernELECTRA, a pre-training recipe that keeps RTD as the main objective and adds a lightweight auxiliary task, boundary-window reconstruction. For every token, we sample a window of 3-12 tokens that strictly contains it and reconstruct the token's original identity only from the discriminator's hidden states at the two window boundaries. The task costs one small FFN at training time and is discarded afterwards, yet it forces every final-layer state to carry information about its neighbourhood. Combined with a frozen, separately pre-trained generator, a temperature curriculum for hard negatives and a 512-to-8192 length curriculum, we train two compact encoders: EdgeCoder-31M, an 8-layer English model, and EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M, a 16-layer model covering 46 languages, each on about 1T tokens. They reach 86.0 and 85.1 on GLUE. The English model outperforms Ettin-Enc-32m (83.5) and MiniLM-L12 (84.6) on GLUE while matching them on MTEB English v2 (51.1), and the multilingual model outperforms the 2.3x larger mmBERT-small on GLUE and Multilingual MiniLM and mDistilBERT on XTREME over the languages it covers. We also describe FlashDeBERTa, our open-source fused implementation of DeBERTa's disentangled attention that stores no $n \times n$ score matrix: at 4096 tokens it is 10x faster and uses 93% less memory than the reference implementation, and it loads existing DeBERTa checkpoints unchanged.
papers.title_ja: ModernELECTRA: 境界ウィンドウ再構築によるコンパクトエンコーダの分類・埋め込み性能向上
papers.summary_ja: ELECTRA方式の置換トークン検出（RTD）は分類タスクに強いが、埋め込みタスクでは弱いという課題に対し、境界ウィンドウ再構築という軽量な補助タスクを追加した事前学習手法を提案する。この手法により、最終層の隠れ状態が近傍トークンの情報を保持するようになり、分類と埋め込みの両方で高性能なコンパクトモデル（EdgeCoder）を構築した。さらに、DeBERTaの注意機構を最適化したFlashDeBERTaを実装し、既存チェックポイントの互換性を保ちつつ推論速度を10倍向上させ、メモリ使用量を93%削減した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・推論高速化・コンパクトモデル設計に直結する手法を含むため

papers.title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. Internally, latent representations retain some domain information, but incompatible realignment can substantially degrade performance, and repeated latent steps can amplify representation-level failures. Thus, while latent representations may preserve information, they do not necessarily ensure effective communication, which also requires compatible realignment, information accessibility, and stable propagation.
papers.title_ja: LatentLens: マルチエージェントシステムにおける潜在インターフェースの再考
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェントシステムにおける潜在表現（ラテン）通信の効果を、エージェント本体（ハーネス）から分離して評価するフレームワーク「LatentLens」を提案する。Qwen3モデルを用いた7つのベンチマーク実験では、同一のハーネスに潜在インターフェースを追加しても精度が向上せず、むしろ大幅に低下するケースがあることを示した。内部要因の分析により、潜在表現は領域情報を保持するものの、実装の互換性（リアライメント）や情報のアクセス性、伝播の安定性が不足すると、表現レベルの失敗が拡大し性能を毀損することが判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に深く関連

papers.title: LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
papers.summary: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL's out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.
papers.title_ja: LUCID: LLM推論評価のための統計的に裏付けられた自己修正
papers.summary_ja: LLMによる推論ステップ評価における系統的な誤りを、再学習なしで補正する手法LUCIDを提案する。プロンプトによる自己修正と設計ベースの教師あり学習（DSL）を組み合わせ、予測された健全性率と専門家評価を一致させることでバイアスを校正する。PRM800Kデータセットにおいて、GPT-5-miniの校正ギャップを大幅に縮小し、誤検知を半減させると同時にエラー検出のF1スコアを向上させた。さらに、このバイアスプロファイルは他のモデルやドメインにも転移可能であり、DSLを用いた推論デバイアシングによりベストオブK選択の精度を専門家レベルに近づけることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論評価の効率化とハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks
papers.summary: Reliably evaluating the capabilities of advanced AI systems is critical for safe development and deployment, yet such evaluations may be undermined by sandbagging, a situation in which a model strategically suppresses capabilities it possesses. Existing work has developed controlled sandbagging settings and methods for detecting or eliciting hidden capabilities, but comparatively little is known about how a model's internal neural computation changes when its capabilities are suppressed. In this work, we study sandbagging through the lens of internal functional organization. Inspired by network neuroscience, we construct functional graphs from attention-head activations and compare their organization under honest and sandbagging conditions while holding the model architecture and weights fixed. Surprisingly, across model architectures and community detection methods, we find a consistent structural signature in which sandbagging is associated with reduced functional connectivity within detected communities. We further demonstrate that this reorganization can guide capability elicitation. Ablating attention heads that exhibit the largest connectivity changes substantially recovers suppressed performance while largely preserving performance under honest behavior. Moreover, incorporating these structural signals further improves existing inference-level and weight-level elicitation methods. Together, our results show that sandbagging is accompanied by systematic reorganization of internal computation and demonstrate that functional network structure can provide both a mechanistic lens for understanding capability suppression and a practical signal for recovering hidden capabilities.
papers.title_ja: アテンションヘッド機能ネットワークへの構造的介入による、サンドバッグされたLLM能力の引き出し
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMが意図的に能力を隠す「サンドバッグ」現象を、アテンションヘッドの活性化から構築した機能グラフの観点から分析する。モデルの重みを固定した状態で、正直な挙動とサンドバッグ時の内部機能組織を比較し、後者では検出されたコミュニティ内の機能結合が減少する一貫した構造的特徴を発見した。この構造変化に基づき、結合変化が大きいアテンションヘッドをアブレーションすることで、抑制された性能を回復しつつ正直な挙動を維持できることを示す。さらに、この構造シグナルを活用することで、既存の推論レベルや重みレベルの能力引き出し手法の精度が向上することが実証された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部構造解析と能力評価・引き出し手法であり、評価手法への関心に直結する。

papers.title: CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agentic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence
papers.summary: A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. At eleven generations per decision against one, it was significantly cheaper than a direct prompt, a cost-aware prompt and an unguarded agent in all 18 household comparisons (mean loss per item 0.28 against 0.57-0.83), in 9 of 18 in the new domains and in 10 of 18 on TRUST-NAV (Holm per set), and never significantly costlier. It executed none of the 142 unsafe test instructions. On a unanimous vote, the minimum-expected-loss rule reduces calibration to one loss-derived threshold, so for two of six model configurations a gate on the vote alone never executed a clear instruction, costing 0.49 per item on TRUST-NAV against CATWAY's 0.13 and 0.09; the fused estimate avoided this on every set.
papers.title_ja: CATWAY: 校正された言語モデルの信頼度を用いたコスト感応型3分岐ロボット意思決定
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ロボットエージェントが指示に対して「実行」「質問」「拒否」の3択を行う際の意思決定フレームワークCATWAYを提案する。誤りのコスト（損失行列）に基づき閾値を決定し、LLMの信頼度と曖昧さ・リスクスコアをロジスティック回帰で融合して確率を推定する。家庭用指示で学習したモデルを凍結し、他のロボット領域や外部ベンチマークTRUST-NAVで検証した結果、直接プロンプトやコスト意識型プロンプトと比較して、不安全な実行をゼロに抑えつつ平均損失を大幅に低減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法、コスト最適化に直結する

papers.title: Byte Patches versus BPE at Matched Data: A Matched-Twin Comparison at 350M Parameters
papers.summary: We compare a MEGABYTE-style byte-patch Transformer with a 64-byte sliding local decoder (local64) to a matched byte-level 8k BPE decoder (BPE-8k) under identical raw bytes, document order, and approximately matched bytes per optimizer step: 350M parameters and 10 billion training bytes. Under matched-span document sliding (identical scored byte ranges), BPE-8k leads with relative gaps of -5.2%, -4.9%, -9.3% and -6.1% in bits per byte (overall, text, code, math; paired bootstrap). Downstream, CharBench equal fine-tuning favors local64 (53.7% vs 40.0%), fact200 favors BPE-8k (16.5% vs 7.0%), and PIQA (raw and length-normalized) and ARC-Easy length-normalized favor BPE-8k after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05; remaining tasks are ties. Evaluation pitfalls that changed conclusions include context-length extrapolation past the BPE training context, bits per token reported as bits per byte, and inconsistent byte denominators. Unlike controlled tokenizer studies that vary the subword tokenizer under a fixed token budget, or FLOP-controlled byte-model scaling studies, we hold the raw bytes, their order and the optimizer recipe fixed and ask whether a fixed-patch byte model can replace the tokenizer at all. Limits: one size, one seed, one 8k vocabulary fixed before the runs, and a known difference in embedding initialization between the twins.
papers.title_ja: 等量データ下でのバイトパッチとBPEの比較：350Mパラメータにおけるマッチドツイン分析
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、350Mパラメータ規模で、バイトパッチ方式のTransformerとBPEトークナイザ方式のモデルを、同一の生バイトデータと学習条件で厳密に比較した。結果、BPE方式がビット毎バイト数（BPB）で優位に立ったが、CharBenchなどの特定タスクではバイトパッチ方式が良好な性能を示した。さらに、コンテキスト長外挿や指標の定義不一致など、評価手法の落とし穴が結論を左右するリスクを指摘している。トークナイザの有効性を固定条件で検証した点で、LLMの効率化や評価基準の確立に寄与する知見を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのトークナイザ設計と評価手法の最適化に直結

papers.title: Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents
papers.summary: LLM agents commonly use the full interaction history as a proxy for state, retaining all past observations and actions regardless of whether they remain relevant. We instead ask what information an agent actually needs to carry forward. We define agent state as a compact abstraction of interaction history that preserves the competence of a fixed reference agent, with the minimal such abstraction as the ideal. Because matching the reference agent's behavior is unnecessarily restrictive and difficult for black-box policies, we define sufficiency through task performance rather than behavior matching. We represent state abstractions as deterministic recursive programs and search over them using an LLM-guided genetic algorithm. Across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, the learned abstractions preserve near-reference task success while reducing mean policy input by up to 71% and 57%, respectively. The resulting programs are directly inspectable, providing an explicit account of what information is retained, updated, and discarded during interaction.
papers.title_ja: LLMエージェントのためのコンパクトな状態抽象化の学習
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントが対話履歴全体を状態として保持する非効率性を解消するため、タスク性能を維持しつつ最小限の情報だけを保持する「状態抽象化」を提案する。状態を決定論的な再帰プログラムとして表現し、LLMをガイドにした遺伝的アルゴリズムで探索する手法を用いる。ALFWorldとScienceWorldでの実験により、参照エージェントに近い成功率を維持しながら、ポリシーへの入力長を最大71%削減することに成功した。学習されたプログラムは人間が直接検証可能であり、エージェントが何を保持・更新・破棄しているかを明示的に示す。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と推論効率化（入力削減）に直結する手法

papers.title: Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models
papers.summary: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.
papers.title_ja: 大規模言語モデルの検証可能な訓練場としてのマルチプレイヤー社会ゲームの探求
papers.summary_ja: LLMの社会的知能を訓練する際、高コストでノイズの多いLLMジャッジに依存する問題を解決するため、ルールが明確なマルチプレイヤー社会ゲームを「検証可能な報酬（Verifiable Reward）」として活用する手法を提案する。Qwen3モデルに対し、教師あり微調整（SFT）と強化学習（RLVR）を適用した結果、より強力なGemma-3-27Bに対して勝率が大幅に向上し、汎化性能も示された。プロンプトエンジニアリングなどの文脈内戦略よりも、検証可能な報酬を用いた訓練の方が、情報共有や証拠確認といった社会的行動の獲得に有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの強化学習・エージェント設計・評価手法の核心を突く

papers.title: Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself
papers.summary: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. The teacher is computed from an anchor copy of the model, which stays frozen and is replaced by the current model once the student's KL to the teacher falls below a threshold, so the teacher improves with the student without chasing its own extrapolation. The outcome reward splits probability between correct and incorrect responses, and the teacher decides which tokens are preferred inside a response. Between refreshes the objective is KL-regularised RL anchored at the teacher, whose optimum tilts the teacher by the reward. On Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, ELGO raises the average avg@8 over five math benchmarks from 62.32 with GRPO to 64.20 and is the best compared method on every benchmark, while spreading the reward over loops falls below the base model.
papers.title_ja: 最後のループを超えて：モデル自身から外挿された教師を用いた強化学習
papers.summary_ja: ループ型言語モデルのポストトレーニングにおいて、最終ループから外挿した分布を教師信号として利用するELGO手法を提案する。この手法はGRPOにトークン単位の蒸留項を追加し、報酬信号が希薄なループ間での学習を改善する。教師モデルはアンカーコピーから計算され、学生モデルとのKL散度が閾値を下回ると更新されることで、自己追従を避けつつ性能を向上させる。数学ベンチマークにおいて、従来のGRPOや報酬分散手法を上回る精度を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論効率化と強化学習手法の改善に直結する

papers.title: Is 4 Bits Enough for EEG Sleep Staging? A Subject-Level Benchmark of MXFP4, NVFP4 and FP8
papers.summary: Staging sleep on a wearable device keeps the raw electroencephalogram (EEG) private and saves the energy needed to transmit it. It also requires small, energy-efficient neural networks. We benchmark 13 post-training quantization (PTQ) configurations, from FP16 to the block-scaled 4-bit formats MXFP4 and NVFP4, for five-stage sleep staging from single-channel Fpz-Cz EEG. We use Sleep-EDF-78 (78 subjects), subject-wise cross-validation, three training seeds, value-exact emulation, and per-subject paired statistics. All 8- and 16-bit formats stay within 0.45 percentage points (pp) of FP32 Macro-F1. With 4-bit weights and activations, an epoch-wise CNN loses 1.98 to 3.04 pp, and a temporal-context network loses at most 1.19 pp. A same-encoder ablation shows that temporal context explains little of this gap. At equal block size, NVFP4 outperforms MXFP4. The first layer, which quantizes the raw EEG, is the most sensitive layer in both networks. Keeping the first and last layers in FP8 brings both tested 4-bit formats within 0.48 pp of FP32. This recipe adds at most 2.1% weight storage, needs no retraining, and is equivalent to quantization-aware training (QAT) within an exploratory 1-pp margin. The 4-bit losses fall on the same subjects across architectures (Spearman correlation coefficient = 0.69 to 0.79), and they reduce N3 recall the most. On the nested Sleep-EDF-20 subset, NVFP4 with FP8 first and last layers again stays within 0.25 pp of FP32. Under MXFP4, however, the ranking of the architectures reverses, and FP8 first and last layers do not fully recover two of the three tested models. In our emulation, NVFP4 with FP8 first and last layers thus loses little accuracy without QAT in both cohorts.
papers.title_ja: EEG睡眠ステージングに4ビットは十分か？MXFP4、NVFP4、FP8の被験者レベルベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: ウェアラブルデバイス向けのEEG睡眠ステージングにおいて、FP16から4ビット（MXFP4, NVFP4）までの13種類のポストトレーニング量子化設定を評価した。8〜16ビットではFP32とほぼ同等の精度を維持するが、4ビットではモデル依存で最大3.04ppの性能低下が見られた。初層と最終層をFP8に保つことで、4ビットでもFP32と0.48pp以内の精度差に抑えられることを示した。この手法は再学習不要で、量子化認識学習（QAT）と同等の性能を達成し、低電力・プライバシー重視のエッジデバイス応用に有効である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化の核心である量子化手法のベンチマークであり、関連度が高い

papers.title: Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space
papers.summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables transformers to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations without updating their parameters. However, theoretical guarantees for transformers remain limited in general, and elusive in particular when target responses depend nonlinearly on the evolution of observed paths. We establish an ICL framework for path space, using path signature features. Building on the universal linear approximation property of signatures, we construct explicitly a causal softmax transformer with two attention heads per layer that emulates in-context Lasso. Under sparse signature approximation and suitable moment and concentration conditions, we establish finite-sample prediction error bounds. Our analysis goes beyond the IID data setting in the existing ICL theory, allowing dependence among demonstrations and the query. Experiments on in-context sparse recovery, nonlinear path regression, execution-cost prediction, and financial payoff inference demonstrate robustness to changes in observation grids and adaptation to unseen market environments. Across these prediction tasks, transformers with signatures match or outperform vanilla transformer baselines with substantially fewer trainable parameters, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of signature-based ICL.
papers.title_ja: シグネチャを用いたTransformer：パス空間における汎用的なインコンテキスト学習へ
papers.summary_ja: パス空間におけるインコンテキスト学習（ICL）の理論的保証を確立するため、パスシグネチャ特徴量を用いたフレームワークを提案する。シグネチャの普遍的線形近似性質に基づき、2つのアテンションヘッドを持つ因果softmax Transformerを構築し、インコンテキストLassoを模倣する。IID仮定を超え、デモデータ間の依存性を許容する有限サンプル予測誤差境界を導出する。金融パフォイン推定などの実験で、既存のバニラTransformerより少ないパラメータ数で同等以上の性能を示し、効率性と頑健性を証明した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と金融・時系列予測への応用が関心に合致

papers.title: Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study
papers.summary: Dense-embedding retrievers can fail adversarially: when a query is answered by a document A and reversed by a near-copy B that differs from A by a small meaning-changing edit (a "trap"), raw cosine over E5-Large-v2 places B in the top-10 for 82-100% of queries at a pool of 5,000. We study two things. First, a small learned projection W: R^1024 -> R^d (d in {11, 32}), trained by a deterministic recipe on a declared set of cases, that suppresses the trap: for the declared cases, HN@10 = 0.0000 (no trap in the top-10) in all twelve (domain, pool-size) settings across four independent domains (legal, medical, patent, financial) and pools up to 100,000, while the correct paraphrase is retained for 93-99% of cases, under exact nearest-neighbour search. Second, a boundary-conditioned accelerator that serves the projection at that scale: an acceleration of spectral graph retrieval (SpectRAG) that replaces a dense eigendecomposition with a boundary-value solve, holding HN@10 = 0.0000 at n = 100,000 in every domain and retrieving the ~300-query suite in 0.6-1.1 s (~2-4 ms per query on average). Because the lens's output is the stored representation (a few floats per document), a hardened, specialised index per domain or tenant is ~90x smaller and dimension-proportionally faster than the full embedding, making many small declared indexes a practical alternative to one large vector store. The claim is scoped to the declared cases on the measured pools, with no probabilistic bound; the correct-answer rate drops for a reworded query against an unchanged corpus (about 0.79, trap suppression still holding). A projection transfers only partly to other domains, which we report in full. The recipe, lenses, trap sets and evaluation harness are released under AGPL-3.0; the accelerator's implementation is a reserved commercial component, and every HN number is reproducible under exact search.
papers.title_ja: スペクトル加速を用いた意味反転認識検索のための小型学習投影：4領域の実証研究
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、類似文書による検索結果の誤り（トラップ）を抑制する小型学習投影行列Wを提案する。E5-Large-v2埋め込み空間において、次元削減（1024→11/32次元）により、4つの独立したドメインでトラップを完全に排除しつつ、正解文書の保持率を93-99%維持することを示した。さらに、スペクトルグラフ検索（SpectRAG）の高速化手法として、固有値分解を境界値問題の解置換に置き換え、10万規模のプールでクエリあたり2-4msの高速応答を実現した。この手法は、ドメイン特化型の小型インデックスを構築可能にし、大規模ベクトルストアへの代替手段として実務的な利点を持つ。
papers.relevance_reason: RAGの検索精度向上と推論高速化、効率化に直結する手法であるため

papers.title: Trust-Region Optimization for Performative Prediction without Response Modeling
papers.summary: Performative prediction studies learning problems in which deployed decisions change the distribution of future data. Existing methods often impose structure on the population response, which limits their applicability when a fixed model class poorly captures that response. Generic black-box optimization avoids response modeling but does not exploit the known loss function. We introduce Performative Trust-Region Optimization (PTRO), which bridges these two approaches by optimizing performative risk without specifying or fitting a response model while still exploiting the known loss. The key idea is sampling from the current population to evaluate the known loss at nearby decisions, and use additional deployments only to estimate the effect of population response. This gives a local approximation of performative risk without committing to a model of how the population responds. PTRO then uses a trust-region mechanism to determine and adapt how far this local information can be trusted. Under moment-bounded losses and suitable smoothness and estimator-accuracy conditions, we establish high-probability convergence to an $\epsilon$-stationary point of the performative risk in $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ iterations, with $O(d^{3}\epsilon^{-4})$ samples per iteration, where $d$ is the decision dimension and $q\geq2$ is the loss-moment order. Experiments illustrate methods built around a specified response model can be more sample-efficient when their structural assumptions are accurate, whereas PTRO remains effective as the population response is poorly captured by a fixed model class. Ablations further show that both exploiting the known loss and adaptive trust-region updates are important for controlling the accuracy and efficiency.
papers.title_ja: 応答モデリングなしのパフォーマティブ予測のための信頼領域最適化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、デプロイされた決定が将来のデータ分布を変える「パフォーマティブ予測」問題において、集団の応答をモデル化せずに最適化を行う手法PTROを提案する。既知の損失関数を利用しつつ、現在の集団からサンプリングして近傍の決定における損失を評価し、信頼領域機構によって信頼できる範囲を適応的に決定する。このアプローチにより、応答モデルの構造仮定が不適切な場合でも、高確率でε定常点へ収束することが理論的に保証される。実験では、応答モデルの仮定が正確な場合は既存手法の方がサンプル効率が良いものの、仮定が外れる場合はPTROが有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 信頼領域最適化というML手法と、非定常環境での適応的学習という実務的課題を扱っており、ユーザーの関心と高い親和性がある。

papers.title: How to build and train your recurrent-depth model: A fixed-point perspective
papers.summary: Recurrent-depth models are trained with truncated backpropagation, yet it remains unclear why this works. We show that input injection, commonly used in recurrent-depth models, is exactly Halpern iteration, and that a slowly vanishing stepsize provably converges with a backpropagation window polylogarithmic in the depth. The guarantees require a Lipschitz operator, which for SwiGLU leads to a weight constraint in both row and spectral norm, while only a row norm constraint for gates. Based on these constraints, we develop an optimizer tailored to each parameter group, Sparrow, which provides a drop-in replacement of Muon/MuonH with no overhead, that speeds up training even beyond recurrent models.
papers.title_ja: 再帰深度モデルの構築と学習：固定点の視点から
papers.summary_ja: 再帰深度モデルにおける切り詰めバックプロパゲーションの収束性を、Halpern反復と固定点理論の観点から理論的に説明する。入力注入がHalpern反復に相当することを示し、深度に対してポリロガリズム的なウィンドウで収束することを証明した。さらに、SwiGLUアーキテクチャにおけるLipschitz条件に基づく重み制約を導出し、これに基づいてMuon/MuonHの代替となる最適化アルゴリズムSparrowを開発した。Sparrowはオーバーヘッドなしで即座に適用可能であり、再帰モデルに限らず一般的な深層学習の訓練速度向上にも寄与する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と深層学習手法の両方に直結する高関連度

papers.title: JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models
papers.summary: Typed probabilistic decision models return distributions over specified answers, such as yes or no, a set of options or levels on an ordered scale. We ask whether their probabilities remain coherent when questions about the same input are reworded, negated, combined, given different options or placed in different batches. JevBench tests this coherence without gold labels. Its 50 metamorphic relations each test one law of probability or choice across five dimensions: representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order and choice-set conditioning. Each test changes the question or batch while keeping the input fixed. Every model receives the same requests, fixed in advance. JevBench-240 contains 12,000 tests across 240 synthetic cases in 12 decision domains. A fixed subset of 1,200 tests, JevBench-mini, closely reproduces the full-suite ranking (Spearman 0.983). Across 21 openly released models, coherence scores range from 56.5 to 83.9. Batch independence holds for most models. Additivity fails broadly, particularly for complements, where the probabilities of a proposition and its negation should sum to one. A uniform reference model ignores the input and scores 89.4 at chance accuracy, exceeding every evaluated model's coherence score. Among decoders, accuracy ranges from 82.4% to 89.2%, while coherence ranges from 64.2 to 83.9. These results show why both measures are needed to assess decision models. JevBench is available as an open-source Python package.
papers.title_ja: JevBench: 型付き確率的決定モデルのためのメタモルフィック整合性テスト
papers.summary_ja: 型付き確率的決定モデル（LLMなど）が、質問の言い換えや否定、バッチ処理の違いに対して確率的整合性を保つかを検証するベンチマーク「JevBench」を提案する。ゴールドラベル不要で、確率論や選択理論に基づく50のメタモルフィック関係を用い、240の合成ケースからなる12,000件のテストを実行する。21の公開モデルの評価では、補集合の確率が1にならない「加法性の失敗」が広く見られ、特にバッチ独立性は保たれるものの、入力無視の均一参照モデルの方が整合性スコアが高いという問題が明らかになった。精度と整合性は相関が低く、両方の指標で評価する必要性を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのハルシネーション対策・評価手法・ベンチマーク設計に直結する

papers.title: Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs
papers.summary: Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.
papers.title_ja: ほぼゼロの忘却は十分ではない：事前学習済みVLAの継続学習における分布外頑健性
papers.summary_ja: 事前学習済みビジョン・言語・アクション（VLA）モデルの継続学習において、経験再生による分布内（ID）での忘却抑制は達成されているが、分布外（OOD）データに対する頑健性が未検証であった。本研究では、LIBEROベンチマークを用い、Pi0モデルの継続学習過程でOOD性能が急速に崩壊することを示した。表現分析により、ドメインシフト時の表現ドリフトが多モーダル特徴とアクション特徴に集中し、線形プローブでタスク関連情報が保持されているが読み取れない「表現の不一致」が起きていることが判明した。ID安定性が保たれていても、表現ドリフトを伴う深刻なOOD忘却が発生しうるという知見は、エージェント設計やモデル評価において重要である。
papers.relevance_reason: VLAエージェントの継続学習とOOD頑健性評価が関心に合致

papers.title: ECLIPSE: Embedding-Centered Foundation-Model Federated Knowledge Transfer for Data-Free Edge Intelligence
papers.summary: Foundation Models (FMs) are envisioned to become an integral component of intelligent federated edge networks because of their strong representation and generalization capabilities. However, their integration into resource-constrained and privacy-sensitive edge environments remains challenging. This challenge is particularly pronounced in data-free settings, where no shared, public, or server-accessible reference dataset is available to establish a common reference space for aligning distributed knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose ECLIPSE, which is an embedding-centered FM-based federated knowledge transfer framework developed for data-free edge intelligence. ECLIPSE enables edge intelligence capitalizing on a server-hosted FM without sharing raw data, local models, or a public reference dataset. It establishes a shared embedding reference space through which edge devices encode their local task knowledge. Only the resulting embeddings are transmitted to the server for alignment and aggregation. Using the aggregated embeddings, the server constructs a task-aware surrogate dataset through an embedding-guided generative process. This surrogate dataset is then used to adapt the server-hosted FM to the downstream task. The adapted FM is subsequently distilled into a lightweight global model and distributed to the edge devices. This process allows edge devices to benefit from both distributed task knowledge and the generalization capabilities of the FM. Experimental results across diverse classification datasets show that ECLIPSE outperforms conventional Federated Learning (FL) and data-free Federated Knowledge-Transfer (FKT) baselines. It also achieves competitive performance compared with databased approaches. Furthermore, the framework remains robust under statistical and model heterogeneity across different data distributions and local architectures.
papers.title_ja: ECLIPSE: データフリーなエッジインテリジェンスのための埋め込み中心の基盤モデル連合知識移転
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、共有参照データセットが存在しないデータフリー環境におけるエッジデバイス向け連合学習フレームワーク「ECLIPSE」を提案する。サーバー上の基盤モデル（FM）を活用しつつ、生データやローカルモデルを共有せずに、埋め込みベクトルのみを伝送して共通の参照空間を確立する手法である。集約された埋め込みから生成されたサロゲートデータセットを用いてFMを適応させ、軽量なグローバルモデルとしてエッジデバイスに配信することで、プライバシー保護と計算効率の両立を実現する。多様な分類タスクにおいて、従来の連合学習やデータフリー知識移転手法を上回る性能と、統計的・モデル的ヘテロジニティに対する頑健性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化とサロゲートモデルの要素を含むが、主眼はエッジ向け連合学習であり、軌道力学との関連は薄い。

papers.title: Stopping criteria in structural reliability analysis: An overview
papers.summary: Stopping criteria have become a crucial component of probabilistic and statistical methods in structural reliability analysis, helping prevent structural defects and failures, as well as inaccurate evaluations of existing structures. Over time, these rules have evolved in both concept and application, whereas their treatment in the literature remains fragmented. They are often developed and presented in connection with specific models or analytical frameworks, obscuring their broader applicability across diverse models and methodologies. On this basis, the aim of this article is twofold. First, it overviews a wide range of stopping rules, drawing on concepts from applied probability and statistics. These strategies include classical methods based on error estimates or variance, and stability detection. While many of these ideas were developed in other fields, they have the potential to offer useful tools for structural reliability tasks like managing sampling, improving surrogate models, and checking for convergence. Second, this article introduces a structured framework to organize past and recent developments in this area. It brings together various stopping criteria, clarifies their conceptual roles, explains their theoretical foundations, and compares their practical strengths and limitations. By relating these methods to common modeling and methodological practices, and by incorporating a systematic comparison of performance aspects such as accuracy, computational cost, and robustness, we aim to identify dominant strategies, highlight shared challenges, and point to directions for further progress.
papers.title_ja: 構造信頼性解析における停止基準：概要
papers.summary_ja: 構造信頼性解析における確率的・統計的手法の停止基準について、文献が断片的である現状を整理し、包括的なレビューを行う。誤差推定や分散、安定性検出に基づく古典的手法から、サンプリング管理やサロゲートモデルの改善、収束判定に応用可能な戦略まで幅広く概説する。さらに、これらの基準を構造化したフレームワークで整理し、理論的根拠や概念的角色を明確にする。精度、計算コスト、頑健性などの性能指標に基づいた体系的比較を通じて、支配的な戦略や共通の課題、今後の進展方向を特定する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルや収束判定の手法は関連するが、構造信頼性という分野特化が強い

papers.title: Geo-SMILE: Statistical Model-Agnostic Interpretability with Local Explanations for Geospatial Machine Learning
papers.summary: Conventional post-hoc explanation methods were developed largely for non-spatial inputs and often provide limited explicit treatment of geographic context. We introduce Geo-SMILE, a model-agnostic framework that distinguishes substantive Feature explanation from geographic-position response through complementary perturbation branches. The Feature branch masks substantive predictors while retaining observed coordinates; the Geo branch relocates geographic units while holding substantive predictors fixed. Following the statistical-distance-weighted surrogate principle of SMILE, input-distribution Wasserstein distances determine coalition locality weights and weighted Ridge surrogates approximate expected black-box predictions. GeoSensitivity, signed in the keep orientation, quantifies fitted-model responses to geographic-player relocation under the specified design. Across crime prediction in Hull, housing-price prediction in Seattle and ride-hailing demand in Chicago, held-out weighted surrogate fidelity ranges from $R_w^2=0.910$ to $0.989$ in the Feature branch and from $0.842$ to $0.906$ in the Geo branch. The framework makes geographic position an explicit object of post-hoc explanation while requiring separate assessment of interpretation, stability and reference dependence.
papers.title_ja: Geo-SMILE: 地理空間機械学習における統計的モデル非依存型解釈可能性と局所説明
papers.summary_ja: 従来の事後説明手法が地理的文脈を十分に扱えない問題を解決するため、Geo-SMILE というモデル非依存フレームワークを提案する。本手法は、実質的な特徴量と地理的位置の応答を補完的な摂動ブランチで区別し、Wasserstein 距離に基づく重み付きリッジ回帰サロゲートを用いてブラックボックスモデルの予測を近似する。犯罪予測や住宅価格予測などの実データセットにおいて、高いサロゲート忠実度（R_w^2 0.842〜0.989）を示し、地理的位置を明示的な解釈対象として定量化する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデル手法を含むが、対象が地理空間MLであり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty
papers.summary: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).
papers.title_ja: Co-DRIS: 結合不確実性下での反応的キャッチングのための物理情報予測的信念と可変インピーダンス学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、感知ノイズと実行誤差が同時に発生するロボティクス環境における反応的キャッチングの課題を解決するため、物理情報世界モデルと可変インピーダンス制御を統合したフレームワークを提案する。具体的には、弾道運動学と接触残差を組み合わせた物理情報モデルで観測欠損を補完し、因果GRUによる信念エンコーダでノイズ除去と遅延のトレードオフを解決する。さらに、トルク層で過減衰状態へ遷移するフェーズ認識型可変インピーダンス制御により、7自由度アームの安定性を向上させる。評価では、単一不確実性だけでなく結合ストレスシナリオでも既存手法を大幅に上回る成功率（66.6% vs 27.6%）と、低ピーク衝撃力を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報モデルと強化学習の応用だが、対象が軌道力学ではなくロボティクス制御であるため。

papers.title: SolarFilNet-V4: Multi-Scale Transformer Vision with Physics-Informed Adaptive Post-Processing for Solar Filament Segmentation
papers.summary: Solar filaments are cool, dense chromospheric plasma structures held by magnetic field lines above polarity inversion lines. Their destabilization triggers coronal mass ejections and severe space weather hazards. Segmenting individual filaments from ground-based GONG H-alpha observations (2048 x 2048 pixels) is challenging due to low contrast, turbulent fibrils, delicate barb structures, and annotator boundary variance. In this technical report, we describe SolarFilNet-V4, a targeted segmentation framework developed for the MAGFiLO 1.0 benchmark (Solar Filament Segmentation Challenge 2026). Our method couples a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2-B1) backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions (k=15) and dual-frequency feed-forward blocks (DFFN) to follow extended flux ropes while capturing thin central spines. A shallow full-resolution convolutional branch operating at 1024 x 1024 preserves high-frequency edge details and mitigates transformer downsampling. We train the network using multi-task supervision over masks, centerline spines, barb boundaries, and pixel-contrastive representations. At test time, we apply 8-fold dihedral test-time augmentation (D4), bilinearly upscale predictions to the native 2048 x 2048 grid, and apply an activity-adaptive post-processing routine that calibrates morphological joining parameters for quiet versus active solar disks. On the official benchmark, SolarFilNet-V4 achieves an out-of-fold validation Panoptic Quality of 0.4340 and a Public Leaderboard score of 0.380. The model contains 15.46M parameters and requires 224.34 GFLOPs per forward pass, reducing parameter count by 36.8% compared to standard ResNet-34 U-Net baselines.
papers.title_ja: SolarFilNet-V4: 太陽フィラメント分割のための物理情報適応型後処理を備えたマルチスケールトランスフォーマービジョン
papers.summary_ja: 太陽フィラメントの高精度なセグメンテーションを目的とした、軽量な Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2) をベースとしたフレームワークを提案する。異方性カーブ線状ストリップ畳み込みやデュアル周波数フィードフォワードブロックを用い、細長い磁気構造と高周波数エッジを同時に捉える。テスト時には8重対称性拡張と、太陽活動度に応じた形態学的パラメータを適応させる物理情報ベースの後処理を適用する。標準的な ResNet-34 U-Net ベースラインと比較し、パラメータ数を36.8%削減しながら、ベンチマークで Panoptic Quality 0.4340 を達成した。

papers.title: Reading Between the Layers: Where Representation Quality Lives, and What Geometry Reveals
papers.summary: Representation quality in pretrained text foundation models is not concentrated at the final layer, yet practitioners routinely probe it there because layer selection without labels has remained an open problem. We present a large-scale empirical study of where layer quality lives across 25 models spanning four architectural families and four pretraining strategies, evaluated on 13 datasets across classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, and multiple-choice question answering. Peak probing layers depend systematically on pretraining strategy and architecture: masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, sequence-to-sequence models shift their peak with task type, contrastive sentence encoders concentrate signal at the final layer under CLS and last-token readouts but peak early under mean pooling, and decoder-only models exhibit distinct phase structure tied to depth. We distill these findings into the Stable Geometry Index (SGI), a closed-form, fully label-free selector with no fitted coefficients combining power-law fit quality, effective-rank capacity, spectral stability, and a weak depth prior. Across 383 evaluation groups SGI improves over the last-layer baseline and lifts Hit@3 from 0.39 to 0.52, recovering 40% of the gap to the oracle without using any labels, and exceeds a supervised ELMo-style layer mix on the matched subset despite using strictly less information. Our ablations also reverse a common assumption in the spectral-decay literature: power-law fit quality is a stronger predictor of layer quality than the exponent's proximity to one.
papers.title_ja: 層間の読み解き：表現品質はどこに存在し、幾何学は何を明らかにするか
papers.summary_ja: 事前学習済みテキスト基盤モデルにおける層ごとの表現品質の分布を大規模に調査し、最終層に偏る慣行への疑問を提起する。25モデル・13データセットでの評価から、アーキテクチャや事前学習戦略によって最適な層が異なることを示した。ラベル不要で閉形式の「安定幾何学指数（SGI）」を提案し、最終層ベースラインより層選択精度を向上させた。スペクトル減衰の文献における通説を覆し、べき乗則の適合度が層品質の予測に有効であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部表現分析であり、推論効率化やモデル理解に間接的に関連する

papers.title: Training decision models for simulating human respondents
papers.summary: Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic respondents in market research, conjoint analysis, and randomized experiments. However, synthetic choice data from off-the-shelf generative LLMs bias downstream econometric inference. Neither proprietary models nor higher reasoning effort reliably reduces this bias. We investigate decision models (System One architectures) for silicon sampling. Using choice training, we update KEV model weights on historical respondent-level choice microdata by conditional maximum likelihood, before inference and without target-study data. Across three model scales, training on two discrete choice experiments lowers treatment-effect error by 22% to 89% on four held-out studies from new domains (vaccines, nutrition labels, consumer rights, and AI) and new response formats. A small choice-trained model outperforms a much larger off-the-shelf model on three of the four studies. Although training on single studies lowers cross-entropy, it can exacerbate treatment-effect error. Choice training thus complements post-inference calibration by providing a stronger starting point for estimating human preferences.
papers.title_ja: 人間のリスポンドントをシミュレートするための意思決定モデルの学習
papers.summary_ja: 既存のLLMが市場調査や conjoint 分析においてバイアスを持つ問題に対し、選択データを用いた条件付き最大尤度法でモデル重みを更新する手法を提案する。この「選択学習」により、4つの新規ドメインにおける治療効果の誤差を22〜89%低減し、小規模モデルでも大規模なオフザシェルフモデルを上回る性能を示した。単一研究での学習はクロスエントロピーを下げても誤差を悪化させる可能性があるため、推論後のキャリブレーションと補完的に使うことが有効である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM活用だが軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: A Generative AI Agent to Emulate Interactive Human-driven Vehicles for Automated Driving Testing in Urban Areas
papers.summary: Realistic modeling of human-driven vehicle (HDV) interactions is essential for automated driving safety testing in urban areas. Existing methods struggle to reproduce realistic safety-critical interactions involving high collision risk for the following reasons: they often assume full observability, overlooking interactions arising from occlusion. Driving styles are mainly characterized by vehicle maneuvers, limiting the diversity of safety-critical interaction behaviors. Moreover, learning signals from safety-critical interactions can be diluted by non-critical driving behaviors. To address these issues, we propose a generative AI agent to emulate interactive HDVs. The agent incorporates field-of-view modeling to account for driver visibility under occlusion and characterizes the interaction process using five metrics spanning its initial, intermediate, and final stages. It automatically learns diverse interaction styles through a dynamic mixture-of-experts network. Through residual reinforcement learning, the agent further refines generated trajectories to match the real-world distributions of safety-critical interaction characteristics. Experiments on the INTERACTION dataset show that our method reduces Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) by 39.9\%--87.1\% across five interaction characteristics compared with a state-of-the-art baseline. Our method achieves greater improvements of up to 87.1\% in final-stage interaction metrics, suggesting that it can reduce error accumulation in long-horizon trajectory generation. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each proposed component, particularly highlighting the importance of residual refinement. Generalization experiments show that our method approaches the performance of full training on unseen intersections with only one epoch of fine-tuning.
papers.title_ja: 都市部における自動運転テストのための、対話的な人間運転車両を模倣する生成AIエージェント
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、都市環境での自動運転安全性テストにおいて、遮蔽や多様な運転スタイルを考慮した人間運転車両（HDV）の対話行動を生成するAIエージェントを提案する。視野モデルと動的Mixture-of-Expertsネットワークを用いて多様な相互作用様式を学習し、残差強化学習により安全クリティカルな相互作用特性の実世界分布に軌道を微調整する。INTERACTIONデータセットでの実験により、既存手法比でJensen-Shannon分散を最大87.1%低減し、長期的な軌道生成における誤差蓄積の軽減と、未知の交差点への高い汎化性能を示した。

papers.title: Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities
papers.summary: Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student's animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student's change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.
papers.title_ja: 閾下学習はモーダル間を横断する
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、言語モデルにおける「閾下学習」現象が、テキストからビジョン・言語モデルへモーダル間転移することを示す。数値列などの無意味データ経由で好みが蒸留されたモデルをテキストエンコーダとして使用すると、拡散モデルが特定の動物をより多く生成するが、色やスタイルは変わらないことを確認した。メカニズム解析により、学生モデルの変化の一定成分がイメージ表現のシフトを説明し、プロンプト全体に依存する概念のみが転移することが判明した。さらに、単一のモデル重みから閾下特性を特定する手法「ウェイトレンズ」を提案し、生成画像に現れない特性も同定できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部メカニズムとRAG関連のモデル挙動理解に寄与するが、効率化や軌道力学とは無関係。

papers.title: Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration
papers.summary: TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks, after excluding ten class-code, metadata or semantically ambiguous targets, LVSE reduces RMSE relative to raw-spectrum TabPFN by 10.22%, 12.80% and 14.52% on average for checkpoints 2.5, 3 and 3.5, respectively, with median reductions of 4.99%, 4.74% and 7.82%. Across 76 classification datasets, weighted F1 increases by 2.22, 2.56 and 3.81 percentage points. The 2.5 classification procedure uses output coding on 15 datasets exceeding the checkpoint's native class limit. GCU alone is less reliable in this implementation. LVSE also improves PLS and Ridge in many cases, with median RMSE reductions of 4.75% and 1.89%. Adding LVSE candidates to an operator-adaptive model is feasible, but a separate 35-task panel derived from the public AOM benchmark shows only small median gains. These results motivate evaluating LVSE alongside existing representation choices. They do not establish that a selector choosing between raw and LVSE inputs will improve every task.
papers.title_ja: スペクトル予測のための局所部分空間エンコーディング：TabPFNからオペレーター適応型キャリブレーションへ
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、近赤外スペクトル予測においてTabPFNの性能を向上させるための局所振動部分空間エンコーディング（LVSE）手法を評価するものである。公開データセットを用いた再分析により、LVSEは生スペクトル入力と比較してRMSEを最大14.52%低減し、分類タスクのF1スコアも向上させることを示した。また、PLSやRidge回帰など古典的なキャリブレーション手法との組み合わせでも有効性が確認された。ただし、オペレーター適応型モデルへの統合では改善幅が小さく、全タスクで常に優位であるとは限らない点に留意が必要である。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習手法の応用だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接的な関連は薄い

papers.title: Hidden Clues in WM-811K: Uncovering the Spatial Signals Behind Wafer Map Prediction
papers.summary: WM-811K (also known as LSWMD) is a wafer map dataset first made publicly available in a 2015 paper by Wu et al. Convolutional neural networks have been used to achieve high classification accuracy on this dataset, yet it's not easy to decipher which features of the dataset are driving that performance. This study attempts to answer this specifically for WM-811K: how much of the predictive performance results from the wafer layout, the count of failed dies, their distance from the center and their exact 2-D location. After analyzing duplicate wafer maps, removing same wafer maps with conflicting labels and ensuring that the same manufacturing lot or exact same map doesn't appear in training, validation and test data, we were left with 25,513 defect-labeled wafer maps from eight classes. We then constructed four variations of each wafer map. The Original was the actual wafer map present in the dataset. The Layout-only kept only the layout of the non-background dies. The Global-shuffle kept the count of failed dies while shuffling them around. The Radial-shuffle randomized the locations of failed dies only in their radial bin, which was chosen out of 8 radial bins based on distance from the center. The data split, preprocessing and CNN architecture remained the same for all four of them. Macro-F1 progressed like this: 0.3829 (Layout-only), 0.5803 (Global-shuffle), 0.7439 (Radial-shuffle) and 0.8563 (Original). These results show that WM-811K contains useful information at several levels: wafer layout, number of failures, distribution of failed dies in a given radius, and exact 2-D locations of the failed dies. Therefore, high classification performance on this benchmark does not come only from learning the exact defect configuration.
papers.title_ja: WM-811Kに隠れた手がかり：ウェハマップ予測の背後にある空間シグナルの解明
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、半導体製造の欠陥予測ベンチマークであるWM-811Kにおいて、CNNが高い分類精度を示す理由を空間的な観点から分析する。ウェハのレイアウト、不良ダイの数、中心からの距離、および正確な2D位置という4つの要素を段階的に変換したデータセットを作成し、それぞれの寄与度を評価した。結果として、正確な欠陥配置だけでなく、レイアウトや不良ダイの分布パターンも予測性能に大きく寄与していることが明らかになった。この知見は、既存ベンチマークの性能評価が特定の空間シグナルに依存している可能性を示唆し、モデルの汎化性能評価やデータセット設計における重要な示唆を与える。

papers.title: Conformalized Tree-Based Gradient Ensembles for Out-of-Distribution Detection and Plausible Recourse
papers.summary: Counterfactual recourse provides actionable feature adjustments that reverse unfavourable predictions made by automated decision models. However, when recourse search optimizes purely against classifier confidence or narrow proxy scores over gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDT), search procedures can exploit boundary artifacts and low-density regions---an instance of Goodhart's law---yielding out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendations that appear favourable nominally while lacking manifold plausibility. In this paper, we study conformalized OOD gating coupled with actionability-constrained counterfactual search across two tabular benchmarks: Adult and Give Me Some Credit (GMSC). Calibrating finite-sample anomaly gates (gate_IF, gate_LOF, and the conjunctive gate_ALL) at significance level delta = 0.05 over isolation forest, local outlier factor, and k-nearest-neighbor signals, we audit generated counterfactuals against held-out GMM and OCSVM detectors alongside ablation studies (gen10, gen100, and relax). Across matched recourse pairs where both constrained and unconstrained searches succeed, gate_ALL significantly reduces held-out OCSVM flags on Adult (N=541, Delta flag_OCSVM = -0.0296, p_Holm = 4.0e-4) and lowers both held-out flags on GMSC (N=540, Delta flag_OCSVM = -0.0346, p = 1.0751e-4; Delta flag_GMM = -0.1663, p = 3.5679e-16) while increasing matched recourse cost (Delta cost = +0.3035, p = 1.3365e-5) and narrowing overall feasibility. Our findings formalize the cost--feasibility--plausibility trade-off and demonstrate how conformal OOD gating audits recourse reliability on tabular ensembles.
papers.title_ja: 分布外検出と妥当なリコースのためのコンフォーマライズされたツリーベース勾配アンサンブル
papers.summary_ja: 勾配ブースティング決定木（GBDT）を用いた反事実リコース生成において、Goodhart's law により分布外（OOD）で不自然な提案が生成される問題を解決する手法を提案する。分離森林や局所外れ値因子などの異常検知シグナルを用いたコンフォーマル OOD ゲートを導入し、Adult と GMSC データセットでその有効性を検証した。結果、このゲートは保持セットでの OOD フラグを有意に削減し、リコースの妥当性を向上させることが示された。一方で、リコースコストの増加と実現可能性の狭小化というトレードオフも確認された。

papers.title: Layer-Readout Interfaces in EEG Foundation Models: Predictive Accessibility and Cross-Dataset Transfer
papers.summary: Intermediate layers often outperform final layers when foundation models are used as frozen feature extractors, but the source of this advantage is unclear. We study this question in EEG foundation models by separating three factors: how representations are read out, whether intermediate layers provide predictive utility beyond the final-layer interface, and whether useful depth structure transfers across datasets. Across five models and three tasks, improving the final-layer readout consistently recovers substantial predictive performance, yet intermediate layers remain advantageous within frozen extraction. We also find that layers selected on one dataset remain useful on another across five dataset pairs and four task families, and that a compact set of source-derived task directions retains predictive value after transfer in sleep staging. Together, these results show that predictive utility varies across depth, and its usefulness depends on how representations are read out and transferred. More crucially, source-selected layers provide a reusable feature interface across datasets, reducing the need for target-side layer search while outperforming final-layer baselines on target datasets.
papers.title_ja: EEG基盤モデルにおける層読み出しインターフェース：予測的アクセシビリティとクロスデータセット転移
papers.summary_ja: EEG基盤モデルを凍結特徴抽出器として利用する際、最終層ではなく中間層が性能を向上させる現象の要因を解明する。読み出し方法、中間層の予測的有用性、およびデータセット間の転移可能性の3要素を分離して分析した。最終層の読み出し改善で性能は回復するが、凍結抽出では中間層が依然として優位であることが示された。さらに、ソースデータセットで選択した層はターゲットデータセットでも有効であり、ターゲット側の層探索を不要にしつつ最終層ベースラインを上回る性能を発揮する。

papers.title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
papers.summary: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 20 runs, the misclassification rate of rejected samples was 2.5 times larger than for retained samples. These results suggest that input divergence can help identify unreliable predictions, providing a strong candidate component for abstention frameworks, along with quality control measures and classifier confidence.
papers.title_ja: ガウス混合間のジェフリー散度を用いたフローサイトメトリーにおけるバッチシフトの検出
papers.summary_ja: 臨床フローサイトメトリーにおいて、データ取得条件の変化による予測信頼性の低下を監視する手法を提案する。各サンプルをガウス混合モデルで表現し、訓練データ基準とのジェフリー散度をモンテカルロ積分で推定することで、モデル非依存の信頼性基準を構築した。急性骨髄性白血病のNPM1変異予測タスクで検証し、拒否されたサンプルの誤分類率が保持サンプルの2.5倍であることを示した。この入力の分布乖離度は、予測棄却フレームワークや品質管理の強力な構成要素となり得る。

papers.title: Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback
papers.summary: A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct sources. With pointwise calibration, they agreed on 5 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 9. A development-set selector with a matched single-source fallback improved ten-refit task-averaged scores by 2.2--6.3% in every implementation under both calibrations. Adding fused arms to the pool of single-source candidates improved the mean relative score by about 5 percentage points. Under group-wise calibration, the gradient-boosted selector met the criterion frozen before evaluation on eight held-out tasks. In post-opening refits, selectors lost to the matched single source in 4.4--6.1% of task-level runs under group-wise calibration. Under signed pointwise calibration, three implementations lost in 19--23% of runs. Fusion evaluations should compare matched candidates on held-out data and report how often the selector loses alongside its average gain.
papers.title_ja: 融合の利得は実装と較正ターゲットに依存する：単一ソースフォールバックを用いた予測区間に関する18タスク研究
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、18の回帰タスクにおいて、異なる融合実装と単一ソース学習器の予測区間性能を比較した。グループワイズ較正下では線形スタッキングが有意な改善を示したが、実装間の評価結果はタスクごとに大きく分岐し、明確な優劣が逆転するケースも多かった。開発セットを用いたセレクタと単一ソースフォールバックの組み合わせにより、全実装で平均スコアが2.2〜6.3%向上した。融合モデルの評価には、保持データ上でマッチした候補との比較と、セレクタが劣る頻度の報告が不可欠であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: ML手法全般に関わるが、軌道力学やLLM特化ではないため中程度

papers.title: CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies
papers.summary: World models is answering ``imagine" answers to ``what-if'' questions via imagined rollouts. But rollouts collected by adaptive policies induce treatment-outcome confounding in imagined rollouts. We study this problem in Match-3 difficulty adjustment, where latent player skill influences both assigned difficulty and churn. We build a fully specified Match-3 SCM with sequential mechanics, adaptive assignment, and paired ground-truth interventions, on which unadjusted models fit to the logged trajectories select difficulty settings that raise churn. We then introduce Causal Latent Adjustment (CaLA), a DAG-constrained world model that infers a variational player representation from pretreatment history. Across our evaluations, CaLA provides the most reliable population-level intervention estimates and competitive individualized decisions, although rich handcrafted histories can remain advantageous for individual-level adjustment. We further find that residual correction can degrade causal decision quality despite improving predictive fit, highlighting the need to distinguish predictive accuracy, confounding adjustment and the behavior of downstream causal estimators.
papers.title_ja: 適応型ポリシー下におけるワールドモデルのための因果的潜在変数調整（CaLA）
papers.summary_ja: 適応型ポリシーによるデータ収集がもたらす交絡を解決するため、DAG制約付きの因果的潜在変数調整手法CaLAを提案する。Match-3ゲームの難易度調整を例に、プレイヤーの潜在スキルが難易度と離脱率に同時に影響する構造をモデル化し、従来の調整なしモデルが誤った難易度設定を行う問題を指摘する。CaLAは事前履歴から変分推論によりプレイヤー表現を推定し、集団レベルの介入効果推定において最も信頼性の高い結果を示した。予測精度の向上と因果的決定の質は必ずしも一致しないため、両者を区別する重要性も強調されている。
papers.relevance_reason: 因果推論と潜在変数モデルはML手法として関連するが、宇宙工学やLLM効率化との直接的な接点は薄い。

papers.title: Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences
papers.summary: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's latent reward. We construct post-intervention preferences by comparing corrected behavior with the behavior it replaces, and pre-intervention preferences from temporal relationships among states leading up to an intervention. We evaluate the learned value representations through two downstream tasks: goal inference and correction forecasting. Our results show that post-intervention preferences are particularly effective for goal inference, while pre-intervention preferences provide strong correction-forecasting performance. Combining both sources of information performs strongly across both tasks, even when generalizing to participants unseen during training. These findings demonstrate that both when and how humans correct provide complementary information for learning value representations from corrective interactions.
papers.title_ja: 時間的選好を通じた人間の修正からの学習
papers.summary_ja: ロボットの行動修正において、介入のタイミング（いつ）と内容（どう）の両方から価値関数を学習する手法を提案する。介入前後の行動比較から得られる選好ペアを用い、潜在報酬を近似する価値表現を構築する。目標推論と修正予測という2つの下流タスクで評価し、介入後の選好は目標推論に、介入前の選好は修正予測に特に有効であることを示した。両者を組み合わせることで、訓練時に見なかった被験者に対しても高い汎化性能を発揮する。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と人間フィードバックの手法だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接的な関連は薄い。

papers.title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
papers.summary: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.
papers.title_ja: XRL4T1D: 1型糖尿病管理における強化学習の事後説明可能性フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 1型糖尿病のインスリン投与制御において、事前学習済み強化学習（RL）ポリシーの意思決定を再学習せずに解釈するための事後説明可能性フレームワークを提案する。SHAPを用いて連続血糖モニター（CGM）とインスリン履歴の重要度を比較し、インスリンオンボードの概念に基づいた時間窓ごとの帰属分析を行う。入力置換実験を通じて、高帰属度入力が出力に与える影響を検証し、PPOやG2P2Cなどのコントローラー間でCGM履歴への依存性が支配的であることを示した。また、説明変数の時間的再現性とコントローラー間比較の頑健性を評価し、帰属の忠実度と時間的安定性を別々に評価すべきであるという知見を得た。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と説明可能性（SHAP）の手法は関心領域だが、応用分野が医療であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係。

papers.title: SOTS: Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection
papers.summary: Training data selection for machine learning models is a critical bottleneck in industrial applications where expert annotation is costly and time-consuming. Existing coreset selection methods for time series either ignore temporal structure entirely or cannot handle variable-length, irregularly sampled, multi-channel signals, the setting most common in industrial monitoring and testing. We introduce SOTS (Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection), an unsupervised coreset selection framework for irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) classification. Each sample is mapped to a truncated path signature, capturing the joint geometric structure of its channels, and the coreset is selected by greedily minimizing the Sliced Wasserstein distance between the empirical signature distributions of the candidate subset and the full dataset, a criterion for which we establish a convergence guarantee for random coresets. We validate SOTS on a real-world, highly imbalanced industrial I&C testing dataset, where SOTS-Greedy exceeds 95% of full-dataset accuracy using only 30% of the training data, outperforming standard coreset baselines at most budgets. This advantage generalizes to public UEA regular multivariate time series benchmarks specifically when class-discriminative information is purely geometric.
papers.title_ja: SOTS: 署名ベースの最適輸送選択
papers.summary_ja: 産業用時系列データのコアセット選択手法SOTSを提案する。各サンプルをパス署名に写像し、スライス・ワッサーシュタイン距離を最小化するよう貪欲法でサブセットを選択する。ランダムコアセットの収束保証を導出し、実世界の非平衡産業データセットにおいて、訓練データの30%で全データ精度の95%以上を達成した。幾何学的特徴が重要な分類タスクで既存手法を上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 時系列のコアセット選択であり、ML効率化に関わるが軌道力学やLLMとは無関係

papers.title: Actionwave: A Systematic Benchmark for Waveform-Centric Clinical Prediction Across Care Scenarios
papers.summary: Continuous bedside waveforms record rapid physiological changes that can inform clinical decisions. Existing benchmarks examine selected prediction conditions, but it remains unclear how model advantages depend on signal duration, warning time, and available inputs across care settings. We introduce Actionwave, a benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across intensive-care, operating-room, and emergency-department settings. Actionwave uses a common decision-time prediction interface and groups clinically grounded tasks by what is inferred and when. It varies conditions relevant to clinical use, including the warning required before an intervention. We compare diverse architectures and pretrained biosignal encoders under specified model-size and compute budgets. The protocol requires patient-level splits, strict information cutoffs, and comparisons that isolate individual modeling factors. Across 20 tasks and 1.4M task-labelled windows from source datasets, the experimental grids account for over 87,000 model fits. These comparisons identify task-specific choices and show why matched cohorts, unimodal controls, and explicit timing are necessary when interpreting waveform model performance.
papers.title_ja: Actionwave: ケアシナリオ横断的な波形中心の臨床予測のための体系的ベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: ICU、手術室、救急外来など異なる医療環境における連続ベッドサイド波形を用いた臨床予測タスクを評価するベンチマーク「Actionwave」を提案する。信号の長さ、警告時間、利用可能な入力など臨床利用に関連する条件を体系的に変化させ、多様なアーキテクチャと事前学習済みバイオシグナルエンコーダを比較する。患者レベルの分割や厳密な情報カットオフを強制するプロトコルにより、87,000回以上のモデルフィッティングを通じて、タスク固有の最適選択とタイミングの重要性を明らかにした。
papers.relevance_reason: 医療波形予測であり軌道力学とは無関係だが、ML手法の体系的ベンチマーク評価という点で関連する。

papers.title: Detecting Harmful Short Videos in Toxic Diet Culture: A Governance-Ready Evidence Framework with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.summary: Algorithmic content moderation is increasingly important for governing short-form video content, yet harmful-content detection research focuses primarily on prediction or limited explanations. This leaves a governance challenge underexplored: producing decision-linked evidence that supports the review and justification of moderation decisions. Using toxic diet culture as an empirical case, we conceptualize governance-ready evidence as computational traceability, evidence localization, policy grounding, and evidence inspectability. We develop the Sparse Autoencoder-based Policy-Aligned Contrastive Evidence (SPACE) framework in a pretrained SAE feature space derived from a large multimodal model. A global relevance gate and decomposable linear evidence head identify decision-linked evidence; segment supervision and within-video ranking localize this evidence; policy alignment maps it to platform guidelines; and Pareto-efficient selection yields a compact, task-specific evidence vocabulary. On 3,711 labeled TikTok videos, SPACE achieves the highest harmful-category Macro F1 among benchmarks across four families, at 0.8507. Its highest-scoring observation overlaps a ground-truth harmful span for 88.0% of harmful test videos, while its evidence representation retrieves the corresponding policy category for 87.0%. Stakeholder evaluations indicate that the SPACE evidence report is perceived as useful for understanding, reviewing, documenting, and responding to moderation decisions. The study contributes computational design science knowledge for embedding governance-ready evidence within predictive content-moderation systems.
papers.title_ja: 有害な短尺動画の検出：スパースオートエンコーダーを用いたガバナンス対応型証拠フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、短尺動画における有害コンテンツ検出において、単なる予測ではなくモデレーション決定を正当化するための「ガバナンス対応型証拠」の生成を目的とする。事前学習済みマルチモーダルモデルの特徴空間上で動作するスパースオートエンコーダー（SAE）ベースのSPACEフレームワークを提案し、決定に関連する証拠の特定・局所化・ポリシー適合性を確保する。TikTok動画3,711本を用いた実験では、有害カテゴリのMacro F1が0.8507と最高値を記録し、証拠の正確性とステークホルダーからの有用性評価も高い結果となった。
